matched_pair_width_cm.interpretation: Straight runs use a nominal 30 cm offset. Curved and mitered portions vary because their paired contour vertices follow separate inner and outer arcs.

recovered_contract: The source dirt/grass transition is a two-ring triangulated contour ribbon, not an independent square fade on every metre cell.
The lawn-side and soil-side vertices use fixed UV2 V endpoints while paired vertices retain the same tangential UV2 U.
UV2 U advances along the contour. It must not vary across the ribbon normal and must not use one diagonal world-space field for every edge orientation.
The exact glassmask01_com RGB and alpha supply the irregular leafy silhouette, surface selector, and source tint.
Representative long source contours span whole atlas repeats at their seams rather than restarting at every grid boundary.

editor_reconstruction.topology: Explicit path_0 through path_15 masks and automatic adjacency are converted into directed clockwise region-boundary edges before any tile surface is generated.
editor_reconstruction.continuity: Collinear edges and corners are chained into deterministic contours. Open contours retain the recovered 0.36 repeats per metre density. Closed contours fit the nearest whole repeat when that remains within 15 percent of the recovered density; very small islands retain source density and place the unavoidable phase reset at a corner.
editor_reconstruction.ribbon: Only missing dirt connections receive a 30 cm transition. At an adjacent lawn seam, the outer 5 cm lattice row joins the canonical clean-lawn repeat-equivalent V=0.928709 to the recovered boundary-lawn V=0.932880402; the remaining 25 cm traverses to the exact soil-side V=0.991155148. UV2 U remains constant across the ribbon while advancing along its contour. The clean outer join prevents the boundary atlas from exposing a straight or ledge-like fragment exactly on the lawn edge.
editor_reconstruction.corners: Where two boundary strips meet, their repeat-equivalent U values blend near the corner instead of shearing a diagonal texture coordinate through both strips.
editor_reconstruction.interiors: Dirt cells without an exposed boundary use the clean canonical soil endpoint. Boundary-bearing editable tiles place the 30 cm inner ribbon seam on an exact lattice row and duplicate that row: ribbon triangles retain the paired tangential U and recovered soil-side V, while interior triangles begin with the clean canonical soil coordinate. No triangle interpolates between those repeat-distant coordinates, matching the source mesh's split topology and removing the false straight green inset. Lawn cells use the clean canonical lawn endpoint.

claim_boundary: The editor grid is a project authoring reconstruction. The material, atlas, UV endpoints, ribbon width, tangential density, and contour behavior are source-measured; the 16 tile-mask identifiers are not claimed to be an original Game Freak tile table.
